name: Finwell Williams
label: Snr Network Engineer
summary:
Enthusiastic and knowledgeable individual with 10 years experience in networking. Possesses the necessary tools and determination needed to resolve, plan design, and configure networking solutions. Equipped
with a proactive attitude, a strong work ethic and a big commitment to keep up to date with the latest technologies.

highlights: Install, Provision and maintain Metro Ethernet network infrastructure
Perform hardware / software upgrades on networking hardware using industry best practices
Provide high level product support and assist NOC with resolving complex problems
Identify risks in network design and capacity planning
Lead and participate in technical as well as non-technical meetings
Create and maintain documents for network configuration and network mapping.
Participate in after hours support
Ensure monitoring platforms deliver network visibility for monitoring uptime
Attend project workshops and define project deliverables for achieving business objectives
Provide telephonic and remote user
Liaise with 3rd party suppliers for faults, ADSL, Diginet,Fibre, Microwave
Monitor clients and core network services using various nms platforms (Cacti, Iris, Smokeping).
Manage Fortigate firewall for business clients
Configure and Install Billion, Mikrotik and Zyxel routers
Provide telephonic and remote user support
Configure and install ADSL routers, 3G modems, VOIP phones and softphones as well as dialup for residential users
Configure and Manage Cisco routers (Wireless and non- wireless) for business clients
Attend to walk-in customers
Email setup
Identify training needs
Liaise with 3rd party supplier for product support
Provided technical e-mail support

Areas of Expertise: Experienced working with Cisco routers and switches (IOS)
Experienced working other vendors like (Extreme Networks, Mikrotik, Ciena, Calix, Ubiquity, Hawei and Juniper)
Working understanding of MPLS and Metro Ethernet protocols (VPLS, VPWS, EAPS, QinQ, etc)
Working knowledge of routing protocols (RIP, OSPF, EIGRP, OSPF, BGP)
